priorityList: Apply Instant Poison and a Non-lethal poison before combat.
Maintain Blade Flurry at all times when 2 or more targets are present.
Use Adrenaline Rush on cooldown, or use Preparation to reset it if it has more than 30 seconds remaining on cooldown.
Cast Roll the Bones if you have 0 or 1 buff active.
Use Keep It Rolling if you have 3 or more Roll the Bones buffs, or 2 buffs if Adrenaline Rush is on cooldown.
Spend Combo Points when at Max CP minus 1. If playing Fatebound and Between the Eyes is on cooldown, you may spend at Max CP minus 2.
Use Between the Eyes as your primary finisher whenever it is off cooldown.
Use Killing Spree as a finisher if Between the Eyes is on cooldown.
Use Coup de Grace as a finisher if Between the Eyes is on cooldown, or as a priority builder if the Disorienting Strikes buff is active.
Use Dispatch as your default finisher and to maintain Slice and Dice.
Use Blade Rush on cooldown for damage and energy replenishment.
Use Vanish or Shadowmeld to trigger Hidden Opportunity if you have no Audacity or Opportunity procs active.
Use Ambush whenever Audacity or Hidden Opportunity is active.
Use Pistol Shot when Opportunity is at max stacks (6) or if you have an Opportunity proc and a large Combo Point deficit.
Use Sinister Strike as your basic filler to generate Combo Points when no other procs are available.
